name: Invoice & Receipt Data Extraction | Ranime Jemal Agency

parameters.content:
## Invoice & Receipt Data Extraction (Google Drive)
Drop invoices and receipts (PDF or photo) in a Google Drive **inbox** folder: the AI extracts supplier, number, dates, amounts, VAT and line items, checks they add up, logs them in Google Sheets and moves the file to a **processed** folder. Anything that does not add up is emailed for review.
(For documents arriving by email, use automation 06.)
1. In **Watch the inbox folder**, pick the inbox folder. 2. Fill in **Settings** (processed folder ID). 3. Make a sheet with a **Documents** tab (`documents-sheet.csv`). 4. Connect Google Drive, Google Sheets, Gmail and OpenAI. 5. Activate.
